title: Two-way Guidance: Simultaneous Learning of Summary Statistics for Generative Bayes
abstract: arXiv:2610.12850v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Bayesian simulation-based inference (SBI) can struggle to recover increasingly concentrated posteriors as observation size grows. We consider learning sufficient summary statistics jointly with the posterior as a general principle for scalable inference in various SBI methods. A common measure taken in SBI is dimension reduction through predetermined summaries, which may partially discard posterior information. Our approach instead imposes structure on how the posterior learner depends on a learned summary (e.g., affinity), and learns the summary simultaneously with the posterior. We identify an important mechanism named two-way guidance: under a structural restriction on the summary, the posterior sufficiency of the learned summary simplifies posterior learning, whereas a suitable posterior objective guides the learned summary towards posterior sufficiency. translated_title: 双向引导：生成式贝叶斯中汇总统计量的同步学习
translated_abstract: 贝叶斯基于模拟的推断（SBI）在观测规模增大时，可能难以恢复越来越集中的后验分布。我们考虑将充分汇总统计量与后验分布进行联合学习，以此作为在各种SBI方法中实现可扩展推断的通用原则。SBI中常见的做法是通过预先确定的汇总量进行降维，但这可能会部分丢弃后验信息。我们的方法则对后验学习器如何依赖于所学习的汇总量（例如亲和性）施加结构约束，并与后验同时学习该汇总量。我们识别出一种名为“双向引导”的重要机制：在汇总量受到结构限制的条件下，所学汇总量的后验充分性简化了后验学习，而合适的后验目标又引导所学汇总量趋向后验充分性。该机制解释了一个反直觉的发现，即结构限制……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 提出“双向引导”机制，通过汇总统计量与后验分布的同步联合学习，使基于模拟的贝叶斯推断在观测规模不断增大时仍能有效恢复集中化的后验分布。
en_tdlr: Proposes a "two-way guidance" mechanism that jointly learns sufficient summary statistics and the posterior simultaneously, enabling scalable simulation-based Bayesian inference as observation sizes grow.
